import numpy as np
import math

def main():
    import sys
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    n = int(data[0])
    P = [int(x) for x in data[1:1+n]]
    NEG = -1e18
    dp = np.full(n+1, NEG, dtype=np.float64)
    dp[0] = 0.0
    for i in range(n):
        p = float(P[i])
        # new_dp[j] = max(dp[j], dp[j-1]*0.9 + p) for j>=1
        cand = dp[:-1] * 0.9 + p
        # keep invalid states as very negative
        cand = np.where(dp[:-1] <= NEG / 2, NEG, cand)
        dp[1:] = np.maximum(dp[1:], cand)
    best = -float('inf')
    denom = 0.0
    pw = 1.0
    for k in range(1, n+1):
        denom += pw
        pw *= 0.9
        val = dp[k] / denom - 1200.0 / math.sqrt(k)
        if val > best:

    print("%.15f" % best)
